filo device
filo device name NAME
filo device new [-y]

  Every register is a device, with a random ID, a signing key and a name (the
  host name when it was made). Decisions shared through a synced directory are
  signed with the key, and another device asks you to compare the key's
  fingerprint before it trusts this one. filo device shows them.

  name renames the device: letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', starting with a
  letter or digit.

  new gives the register a new ID and key, keeping its name, after asking. It is
  for a register copied from another machine: two machines must never share one
  device. A register restored on the same machine stays the same device and
  needs nothing.

Flags
  -y                       new: without asking
